channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Ardour 9.8 released
item.description: What's new in the latest release of Ardour: great new features, quality-of-life improvements, and bugfixes (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in additional AWS Regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) P6-B300 instances are available in Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) and South America (Sao Paulo) Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 3.13 (compatible with MySQL 8.0.45) is generally available
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 3 (compatible with MySQL 8.0) supports MySQL 8.0.45, which includes community MySQL fixes and Aurora-specific improvements. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch agent adds support for journald logs
item.description: AWS announces support for collecting systemd journal (journald) logs with the Amazon CloudWatch agent. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Redshift streaming can now ingest 10MiB records from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
item.description: Amazon Redshift now supports Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (KDS) record sizes up to 10 MiB—a 10x increase from the previous 1 MiB limit—fully matching the expanded maximum record size in Amazon KDS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cosmos3-Edge, Cosmos3-Nano, and Cosmos3-Super models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: NVIDIA's Cosmos3-Edge, Cosmos3-Nano, and Cosmos3-Super models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Muse-Glimmer-30B and Qwen 3.8-27B models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: Meta's Muse-Glimmer-30B and Alibaba's Qwen 3.8-27B models are now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers. (1 source: aws)
